Go, borrow... empty vessels; borrow not a few. And... thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full. 2 Ki. 4:3-4; Lk. 24:49; 2 Tim. 2:20-21
